mentions.name: Listendock
mentions.description: A web app (companion to an existing iPhone app) that turns documents into audio so users can listen to them, with playback controls such as skipping forward or back 10 seconds, including support for car steering-wheel skip buttons when connected.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I just published the web app for https://listendock.com
You can listen to your documents. I also have an iPhone app (that was first).
